items_flat.title_en: Cursor closes acquisition by SpaceX, joins SpaceXAI to advance Grok
items_flat.title_zh: Cursor 正式被 SpaceX 收購完成，加入 SpaceXAI 推進 Grok
items_flat.summary_en: Cursor announced that its acquisition by SpaceX has officially closed. The team will join SpaceXAI to help make Grok the world’s most useful AI and improve Grok Build, Grok Bot, the Grok API, and Cursor itself. The company gains access to the largest fleet of GPUs, enabling stronger and more economical models.
items_flat.summary_zh: Cursor 宣布其被 SpaceX 收購已正式完成。團隊將加入 SpaceXAI，協助讓 Grok 成為全球最有用的 AI，並改進 Grok Build、Grok Bot、Grok API 與 Cursor 本身。公司獲得全球最大 GPU 叢集存取權，可打造更強且更經濟的模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: This integrates a leading AI coding agent directly into the SpaceXAI/Grok stack, creating tighter data feedback loops and distribution. Success hinges on how quickly the combined team converts compute advantage into measurable agent and coding gains versus rivals.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉將領先的 AI 程式設計代理直接整合進 SpaceXAI/Grok 技術棧，形成更緊密的數據回饋與分發循環。成敗關鍵在於合併後的團隊能否快速把算力優勢轉化為可衡量的代理與編碼能力提升。
items_flat.quote: Today, we have officially closed our acquisition. We will join the @SpaceXAI team to help make Grok the world's most useful AI and improve Grok Build, Grok Bot, Grok API, Cursor, and more.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們正式完成了收購。我們將加入 @SpaceXAI 團隊，協助讓 Grok 成為全球最有用的 AI，並改進 Grok Build、Grok Bot、Grok API、Cursor 等。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic publishes August 2026 Risk Report under Responsible Scaling Policy
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 發布 2026 年 8 月風險報告（Responsible Scaling Policy）
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic released its second Risk Report (coverage to 15 July). It rates catastrophic risks from Mythos 5 and the stronger internal Model 2 as Low overall. Misalignment risk in high-stakes settings was raised from very low to low due to cybersecurity-evaluation uncertainty; early signs of R&D automation acceleration appear but remain below RSP thresholds; chem/bio risks stay Low with substantial uncertainty for novel threats. Model 2 will not be released externally for now.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布第二份風險報告（涵蓋至 7 月 15 日）。報告將 Mythos 5 與更強的內部 Model 2 的災難風險整體評為 Low。高風險場景的錯位風險因網路安全評估不確定性，從 very low 上調至 low；自動 R&D 加速出現早期跡象但仍低於 RSP 門檻；化學／生物風險維持 Low，新穎威脅存在高度不確定性。Model 2 目前不對外發布。
items_flat.analysis_en: The upward revision on misalignment and eval saturation highlight measurement challenges at the frontier even while absolute risk levels remain Low. Non-release of Model 2 prioritizes caution but reduces external visibility into Anthropic’s true capability trajectory.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 錯位風險上調與評估飽和凸顯前沿風險衡量的困難，儘管絕對風險水準仍為 Low。不發布 Model 2 展現謹慎，但也降低外界對 Anthropic 真實能力軌跡的可見度。
items_flat.quote: As part of our Responsible Scaling Policy, we publish regular Risk Reports. These share detailed information on the risks of our systems and how prepared we are to address them. Our second Risk Report is now available.
items_flat.quote_zh: 作為我們 Responsible Scaling Policy 的一部分，我們定期發布風險報告。這些報告詳細說明系統風險及我們的應對準備。我們的第二份風險報告現已發布。

items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 3.7 Flash, its most capable workhorse model for coding and agents
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash，迄今最強的編碼與代理主力模型
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 3.7 Flash, described as its most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents. It delivers substantial gains over 3.6 Flash on coding benchmarks (FrontierCode 43.6% vs 34.4%, DeepSWE 65.3% vs 49.0%) and is rolling out across the Gemini API, Spark, Workspace and the Gemini app.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini 3.7 Flash，稱為迄今最強的編碼與代理主力模型。相較 3.6 Flash，在編碼基準上大幅提升（FrontierCode 43.6% vs 34.4%、DeepSWE 65.3% vs 49.0%），並陸續上線 Gemini API、Spark、Workspace 與 Gemini 應用。
items_flat.analysis_en: Rapid iteration on the Flash line (3.5→3.7 in three months) keeps Google competitive on cost-sensitive agent workloads. The price cut plus measurable coding gains lower the barrier for production agent use.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Flash 系列快速迭代（三個月內從 3.5 到 3.7）讓 Google 在成本敏感的代理工作負載上保持競爭力。降價加上可衡量的編碼提升，降低了生產級代理應用門檻。
items_flat.quote: Gemini 3.7 Flash is our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents.
items_flat.quote_zh: Gemini 3.7 Flash 是我們迄今最強的工作馬型模型，專為 coding 與 agent 打造。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI previews Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol, up to 14× faster via Cerebras
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 預覽 GPT-5.6 Sol 超高速模式，透過 Cerebras 最高快 14 倍
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol, delivering up to 14× the speed of standard processing and up to 750 output tokens per second, powered by Cerebras. It launches first in the OpenAI API to a select group of customers, with broader access planned.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布 GPT-5.6 Sol 的超高速模式，標準處理速度最高可達 14 倍，每秒最多輸出 750 tokens，由 Cerebras 提供支援。率先在 OpenAI API 向選定客戶推出，後續將擴大開放。
items_flat.analysis_en: Ultra-low-latency frontier inference opens real-time use cases (voice, interactive coding, support) that were previously impractical. Success depends on how quickly capacity scales beyond the initial select group.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 超低延遲前沿推論開啟先前不切實際的即時應用（語音、互動編碼、客服）。成敗取決於產能能否快速從初期選定客戶擴大規模。
items_flat.quote: Previewing Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14x the speed. Launching first in the OpenAI API to a select group of customers with expanded access to more businesses as capacity grows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 預覽 Ultrafast 模式：GPT-5.6 Sol 最高 14 倍速度。首先在 OpenAI API 向精選客戶推出，隨產能成長再擴及更多企業。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic details Claude’s text watermark for EU AI Act compliance
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 詳解 Claude 文字浮水印以符合歐盟 AI 法案
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic published a detailed explanation of how future Claude models will embed an invisible text watermark based on Google DeepMind’s SynthID-Text approach. The method alters randomness in word selection using a secret key, has no practical impact on quality, cost or readability, cannot be traced to individuals, and is being rolled out globally to comply with the EU AI Act.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布詳細說明，未來 Claude 模型將內建基於 Google DeepMind SynthID-Text 的不可見文字浮水印。該方法透過秘密金鑰改變詞彙選擇的隨機性，對品質、成本或可讀性無實際影響，無法追蹤個人，並全球推行以符合歐盟 AI 法案。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is industry-wide regulatory compliance rather than a capability advance. Detection is only probabilistic and weak on short, factual or code text; real-world robustness against rewriting or multi-model pipelines remains uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉屬產業共同的法規合規，而非能力突破。偵測僅為機率性，且對短文、事實性或程式碼文字效果有限；面對改寫或多模型混用時的真實世界強健性仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Future Claude models will generate text that contains a watermark. This is a way of determining the likelihood that Claude was involved in writing the text, and we, along with several other major AI providers, are implementing this change to comply with the EU AI Act.
items_flat.quote_zh: 未來的 Claude 模型將產生含有浮水印的文字。這是一種判斷 Claude 是否參與撰寫文字的方式，我們與其他主要 AI 供應商正實施此變更以符合歐盟 AI 法案。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI appoints Dali Rajic as Chief Revenue Officer
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 任命 Dali Rajic 為首席營收長
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI named Dali Rajic (formerly President & COO of Wiz) as Chief Revenue Officer to lead its global revenue organization. He succeeds Denise Dresser, who is departing after a transition period.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 任命前 Wiz 總裁暨營運長 Dali Rajic 為首席營收長，負責全球營收組織。他接替 Denise Dresser，後者將在過渡期後離職。
items_flat.analysis_en: The appointment signals continued focus on enterprise scale and go-to-market discipline amid rapid revenue growth and executive turnover. It comes as OpenAI prepares for a potential public listing.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此任命顯示在營收快速成長與高階主管流動之際，仍持續聚焦企業規模與市場拓展紀律。時機正好在 OpenAI 準備可能公開上市之際。
items_flat.quote: Dali will build the revenue operating system needed to scale for this next phase.
items_flat.quote_zh: Dali 將打造擴展下一階段所需的營收作業系統。

items_flat.title_en: ChatGPT desktop on Mac gains Computer History feature
items_flat.title_zh: ChatGPT Mac 桌面版新增 Computer History 功能
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI rolled out Computer History, an opt-in feature in the ChatGPT desktop app on Mac that lets the model remember activity across selected apps and websites. It builds a timeline and can suggest skills or automations from recurring tasks.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 Mac 版 ChatGPT 桌面應用推出選用式 Computer History 功能，讓模型能記住選定應用與網站的活動。它會建立時間軸，並可從重複任務建議技能或自動化。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moving from screenshot-based Chronicle to accessibility-event history reduces friction and privacy concerns while enabling deeper personalization. Adoption will hinge on user trust in the opt-in controls.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 從以截圖為基礎的 Chronicle 轉向無障礙事件歷史，降低摩擦與隱私疑慮，同時實現更深層個人化。採用率將取決於使用者對選用控制的信任。
items_flat.quote: ChatGPT can now remember your activity across the apps and websites on your computer. With Computer History in the desktop app, future interactions feel more personalized and require less explanation.
items_flat.quote_zh: ChatGPT 現在可以記住你在電腦上跨 App 與網站的活動。透過桌面版的 Computer History，未來互動會更個人化，也需要更少解釋。

items_flat.title_en: Hugging Face releases State of Open Models, Summer 2026 report
items_flat.title_zh: Hugging Face 發布 2026 夏季開源模型現況報告
items_flat.summary_en: Hugging Face published its State of Open Models Summer 2026 observations. Key findings include frontier models growing larger (especially from Chinese labs), small models still dominating real-world downloads, Qwen leading local inference and derivatives, and AI agents becoming a major force on the Hub.
items_flat.summary_zh: Hugging Face 發布 2026 夏季開源模型現況觀察。關鍵發現包括前沿模型規模持續擴大（尤其中國實驗室）、小型模型仍主導真實下載量、Qwen 領先本地推論與衍生模型，以及 AI 代理成為 Hub 上的重要力量。
items_flat.analysis_en: The report quantifies the continued shift toward Chinese open-weight leadership in scale and community adoption, while underscoring that practical usage remains dominated by smaller, efficient models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 報告量化了中國開源權重模型在規模與社群採用上的持續領先，同時強調實際使用仍由較小且高效的模型主導。
items_flat.quote: The State of Open Models, Summer 2026 ☀️ frontier models are getting larger, but small models still dominate real-world usage. Qwen leads local inference, followed by Gemma. AI agents are becoming a major force on the Hub
items_flat.quote_zh: 2026 夏季開源模型現況：前沿模型越來越大，但小型模型仍主導真實世界使用。Qwen 領先本地推論，其次是 Gemma。AI 代理正成為 Hub 上的重要力量

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA and LG deepen partnership on humanoid robots using Isaac GR00T
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 與 LG 深化人形機器人合作，採用 Isaac GR00T
items_flat.summary_en: LG and NVIDIA signed an MOU to develop a next-generation bipedal humanoid robot based on NVIDIA’s Isaac GR00T foundation model and Jetson Thor, targeting a Q1 2027 unveil. The collaboration also expands into AI infrastructure, physical AI, and related areas.
items_flat.summary_zh: LG 與 NVIDIA 簽署備忘錄，將以 NVIDIA Isaac GR00T 基礎模型與 Jetson Thor 開發下一代雙足人形機器人，目標 2027 年第一季亮相。合作也擴及 AI 基礎設施與實體 AI 等領域。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal underscores NVIDIA’s push to embed its robotics stack into major hardware partners’ products. Success will depend on real-world reliability of GR00T-based systems and whether the timeline holds.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此協議凸顯 NVIDIA 將其機器人技術棧嵌入主要硬體夥伴產品的意圖。成敗取決於基於 GR00T 系統的真實世界可靠性，以及時程能否如期達成。
items_flat.quote: Great to welcome @LGE_Global Group Chairman Kwang-mo Koo and LG leaders to NVIDIA as we enter the next chapter of our collaboration. Together, we’re expanding our work across AI infrastructure, physical AI and robotics.
items_flat.quote_zh: 很高興歡迎 @LGE_Global 集團會長具光謨與 LG 領導層造訪 NVIDIA，共同開啟合作新篇章。我們將在 AI 基礎設施、物理 AI 與機器人領域擴大合作。

google.quote: Gemini 3.7 Flash is our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents.
google.quote_zh: Gemini 3.7 Flash 是我們迄今最強的工作馬型模型，專為 coding 與 agent 打造。

xai.title_en: Cursor closes acquisition by SpaceX, joins SpaceXAI to advance Grok
xai.title_zh: Cursor 正式被 SpaceX 收購完成，加入 SpaceXAI 推進 Grok
xai.summary_en: Cursor announced that its acquisition by SpaceX has officially closed. The team will join SpaceXAI to help make Grok the world’s most useful AI and improve Grok Build, Grok Bot, the Grok API, and Cursor itself. The company gains access to the largest fleet of GPUs, enabling stronger and more economical models.
xai.summary_zh: Cursor 宣布其被 SpaceX 收購已正式完成。團隊將加入 SpaceXAI，協助讓 Grok 成為全球最有用的 AI，並改進 Grok Build、Grok Bot、Grok API 與 Cursor 本身。公司獲得全球最大 GPU 叢集存取權，可打造更強且更經濟的模型。
xai.analysis_en: This integrates a leading AI coding agent directly into the SpaceXAI/Grok stack, creating tighter data feedback loops and distribution. Success hinges on how quickly the combined team converts compute advantage into measurable agent and coding gains versus rivals.
xai.analysis_zh: 此舉將領先的 AI 程式設計代理直接整合進 SpaceXAI/Grok 技術棧，形成更緊密的數據回饋與分發循環。成敗關鍵在於合併後的團隊能否快速把算力優勢轉化為可衡量的代理與編碼能力提升。
xai.quote: Today, we have officially closed our acquisition. We will join the @SpaceXAI team to help make Grok the world's most useful AI and improve Grok Build, Grok Bot, Grok API, Cursor, and more.
xai.quote_zh: 今天，我們正式完成了收購。我們將加入 @SpaceXAI 團隊，協助讓 Grok 成為全球最有用的 AI，並改進 Grok Build、Grok Bot、Grok API、Cursor 等。

frontier_other.title_en: Hugging Face releases State of Open Models, Summer 2026 report
frontier_other.title_zh: Hugging Face 發布 2026 夏季開源模型現況報告
frontier_other.summary_en: Hugging Face published its State of Open Models Summer 2026 observations. Key findings include frontier models growing larger (especially from Chinese labs), small models still dominating real-world downloads, Qwen leading local inference and derivatives, and AI agents becoming a major force on the Hub.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Hugging Face 發布 2026 夏季開源模型現況觀察。關鍵發現包括前沿模型規模持續擴大（尤其中國實驗室）、小型模型仍主導真實下載量、Qwen 領先本地推論與衍生模型，以及 AI 代理成為 Hub 上的重要力量。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The report quantifies the continued shift toward Chinese open-weight leadership in scale and community adoption, while underscoring that practical usage remains dominated by smaller, efficient models.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 報告量化了中國開源權重模型在規模與社群採用上的持續領先，同時強調實際使用仍由較小且高效的模型主導。
frontier_other.quote: The State of Open Models, Summer 2026 ☀️ frontier models are getting larger, but small models still dominate real-world usage. Qwen leads local inference, followed by Gemma. AI agents are becoming a major force on the Hub
frontier_other.quote_zh: 2026 夏季開源模型現況：前沿模型越來越大，但小型模型仍主導真實世界使用。Qwen 領先本地推論，其次是 Gemma。AI 代理正成為 Hub 上的重要力量

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA and LG deepen partnership on humanoid robots using Isaac GR00T
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA 與 LG 深化人形機器人合作，採用 Isaac GR00T
frontier_other.summary_en: LG and NVIDIA signed an MOU to develop a next-generation bipedal humanoid robot based on NVIDIA’s Isaac GR00T foundation model and Jetson Thor, targeting a Q1 2027 unveil. The collaboration also expands into AI infrastructure, physical AI, and related areas.
frontier_other.summary_zh: LG 與 NVIDIA 簽署備忘錄，將以 NVIDIA Isaac GR00T 基礎模型與 Jetson Thor 開發下一代雙足人形機器人，目標 2027 年第一季亮相。合作也擴及 AI 基礎設施與實體 AI 等領域。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The deal underscores NVIDIA’s push to embed its robotics stack into major hardware partners’ products. Success will depend on real-world reliability of GR00T-based systems and whether the timeline holds.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 此協議凸顯 NVIDIA 將其機器人技術棧嵌入主要硬體夥伴產品的意圖。成敗取決於基於 GR00T 系統的真實世界可靠性，以及時程能否如期達成。
frontier_other.quote: Great to welcome @LGE_Global Group Chairman Kwang-mo Koo and LG leaders to NVIDIA as we enter the next chapter of our collaboration. Together, we’re expanding our work across AI infrastructure, physical AI and robotics.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 很高興歡迎 @LGE_Global 集團會長具光謨與 LG 領導層造訪 NVIDIA，共同開啟合作新篇章。我們將在 AI 基礎設施、物理 AI 與機器人領域擴大合作。

brief_en: Cursor’s acquisition by SpaceX formally closed; the team joins SpaceXAI to accelerate Grok. Anthropic detailed Claude’s invisible text watermark for EU AI Act compliance and published its August Risk Report, raising some catastrophic-risk ratings to Low while keeping overall levels low. Google continued Gemini 3.7 Flash rollout; Hugging Face released its Summer 2026 open-models report.
brief_zh: Cursor 正式被 SpaceX 收購完成，團隊加入 SpaceXAI 加速 Grok。Anthropic 詳解 Claude 文字浮水印以符合歐盟 AI 法，並發布 8 月風險報告，部分災難風險評級上調至 Low。Google 持續推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash；Hugging Face 發布 2026 夏季開源模型報告。
